bard.name: Bard
bard.description: Bards are masters of captivation and specialize in performance types including singing, playing instruments, weaving tales, or telling jokes. They thrive in social situations.
bard.classItems: A romance novel or a letter never opened

hopeFeature.name: Make a Scene
hopeFeature.description: Spend 3 Hope to temporarily Distract a target within Close range, giving them a -2 penalty to their Difficulty.

classFeatures.name: Rally
classFeatures.description: Once per session, describe how you rally the party and give yourself and each ally a Rally Die (d6 at level 1, d8 at level 5). A PC can spend their Rally Die to roll it, adding the result to their action roll, reaction roll, damage roll, or to clear Stress equal to the result.

features.name: Gifted Performer
features.description: Play three types of songs once each per long rest

features.name: Maestro
features.description: When you give a Rally Die to an ally, they can gain a Hope or clear a Stress

features.name: Virtuoso
features.description: Perform each song twice per long rest

features.name: Rousing Speech
features.description: Once per long rest, all allies within Far range clear 2 Stress

features.name: Heart of a Poet
features.description: Spend a Hope to add d4 to action rolls to impress/persuade/offend

features.name: Eloquent
features.description: Once per session, provide various aids to allies

features.name: Epic Poetry
features.description: Rally Die increases to d10

druid.name: Druid
druid.description: Druids learn from and protect the magic of the wilderness. They can transform into beasts and shape nature itself.
druid.classItems: A small bag of rocks and bones or a strange pendant

hopeFeature.name: Evolution
hopeFeature.description: Spend 3 Hope to transform into Beastform without marking Stress. Choose one trait to raise by +1 until you drop out.

classFeatures.name: Beastform
classFeatures.description: Mark a Stress to transform into a creature from the Beastform list

classFeatures.name: Wildtouch
classFeatures.description: Perform harmless nature effects at will

features.name: Elemental Incarnation
features.description: Channel Fire, Earth, Water, or Air with unique effects

features.name: Elemental Aura
features.description: Assume an aura matching your element

features.name: Elemental Dominion
features.description: Further embody your element

features.name: Clarity of Nature
features.description: Create a space of serenity to clear Stress

features.name: Regeneration
features.description: Spend 3 Hope to clear 1d4 Hit Points on a touched creature

features.name: Warden's Protection
features.description: Clear 2 HP on 1d4 allies

features.name: Defender
features.description: Reduce ally damage while in Beastform

guardian.name: Guardian
guardian.description: Guardians are known for fighting with remarkable ferocity even against overwhelming odds, defending their cohort above all else.
guardian.classItems: A totem from your mentor or a secret key

hopeFeature.name: Frontline Tank
hopeFeature.description: Spend 3 Hope to clear 2 Armor Slots.

classFeatures.name: Unstoppable
classFeatures.description: Once per long rest, become Unstoppable with an Unstoppable Die (d4 at level 1, d6 at level 5). While Unstoppable: reduce physical damage severity by one threshold, add Unstoppable Die value to damage roll, can't be Restrained or Vulnerable.

features.name: Unwavering
features.description: +1 to damage thresholds

features.name: Iron Will
features.description: Mark additional Armor Slot to reduce severity

features.name: Unrelenting
features.description: +2 to damage thresholds

features.name: Undaunted
features.description: +3 to damage thresholds, Loyal Protector

features.name: At Ease
features.description: Additional Stress slot

features.name: Revenge
features.description: Mark 2 Stress to force attacker to mark a Hit Point

features.name: Act of Reprisal
features.description: +1 Proficiency against damaging adversary

features.name: Nemesis
features.description: Prioritize an adversary for special benefits

ranger.name: Ranger
ranger.description: Rangers are highly skilled hunters who become sly tacticians, pursuing quarry with cunning and patience.
ranger.classItems: A trophy from your first kill or a seemingly broken compass

hopeFeature.name: Hold Them Off
hopeFeature.description: Spend 3 Hope when you succeed on an attack to use that roll against two additional adversaries.

classFeatures.name: Ranger's Focus
classFeatures.description: Spend a Hope to make a target your Focus, gaining: know their precise direction, target must mark Stress when you deal damage, can reroll Duality Dice on failed attacks against them.

features.name: Companion
features.description: Animal companion that stays by your side

features.name: Expert Training
features.description: Additional level-up option for companion

features.name: Advanced Training
features.description: Two additional level-up options, Loyal Friend

features.name: Ruthless Predator
features.description: Mark Stress for +1 Proficiency

features.name: Path Forward
features.description: Identify shortest path to visited locations

features.name: Elusive Predator
features.description: +2 Evasion against Focus attacks

features.name: Apex Predator
features.description: Remove Fear from GM pool on successful Focus attack

rogue.name: Rogue
rogue.description: Rogues are scoundrels who move through the world anonymously, utilizing sharp wits and blades.
rogue.classItems: A set of forgery tools or a grappling hook

hopeFeature.name: Rogue's Dodge
hopeFeature.description: Spend 3 Hope to gain +2 Evasion until attacked successfully or next rest.

classFeatures.name: Sneak Attack
classFeatures.description: Add d6s equal to tier to damage while Cloaked or ally is near target

features.name: Shadow Stepper
features.description: Move from shadow to shadow, becoming Cloaked

features.name: Dark Cloud
features.description: Create temporary dark cloud

features.name: Fleeting Shadow
features.description: +1 Evasion, extended Shadow Stepper range

features.name: Well-Connected
features.description: Know someone in every prominent location

features.name: Contacts Everywhere
features.description: Call on shady contacts once per session

features.name: Reliable Backup
features.description: Use contacts three times per session

seraph.name: Seraph
seraph.description: Seraphs are divine fighters and healers imbued with sacred purpose.
seraph.classItems: A bundle of offerings or a sigil of your god

hopeFeature.name: Life Support
hopeFeature.description: Spend 3 Hope to clear a Hit Point on an ally within Close range.

classFeatures.name: Prayer Dice
classFeatures.description: Roll d4s equal to Spellcast trait at session start. Spend to aid yourself or allies: reduce damage, add to rolls, or gain Hope.

features.name: Spirit Weapon
features.description: Equipped Melee/Very Close weapon can attack at Close range

features.name: Sparing Touch
features.description: Clear 2 HP or 2 Stress once per long rest

features.name: Devout
features.description: Roll extra Prayer Die, use Sparing Touch twice

features.name: Sacred Resonance
features.description: Double matching damage dice

features.name: Wings of Light
features.description: Fly, carry creatures, deal extra damage

features.name: Ethereal Visage
features.description: Advantage on Presence Rolls while flying

features.name: Ascendant
features.description: +4 to Severe threshold

features.name: Power of the Gods
features.description: Deal 1d12 extra damage while flying

sorcerer.name: Sorcerer
sorcerer.description: Sorcerers cultivate and control innate magical power passed down through families.
sorcerer.classItems: A whispering orb or a family heirloom

hopeFeature.name: Volatile Magic
hopeFeature.description: Spend 3 Hope to reroll any damage dice on magic damage attacks.

classFeatures.name: Arcane Sense
classFeatures.description: Sense magical people and objects within Close range

classFeatures.name: Minor Illusion
classFeatures.description: Create visual illusions within Close range

classFeatures.name: Channel Raw Power
classFeatures.description: Place domain card in vault to gain Hope or enhance damage

features.name: Elementalist
features.description: Choose air, earth, fire, lightning, or water; shape element

features.name: Natural Evasion
features.description: Add d6 to Evasion against attacks

features.name: Transcendence
features.description: Transform into physical manifestation of element

features.name: Manipulate Magic
features.description: Mark Stress after spells to extend reach, add bonuses, etc.

features.name: Enchanted Aid
features.description: Roll d8 when helping ally with Spellcast

features.name: Arcane Charge
features.description: Gather magical energy to enhance capabilities

warrior.name: Warrior
warrior.description: Warriors master weapons and violence through training and dedication, understanding the importance of an agile body and mind.
warrior.classItems: The drawing of a lover or a sharpening stone

hopeFeature.name: No Mercy
hopeFeature.description: Spend 3 Hope to gain +1 to attack rolls until next rest.

classFeatures.name: Attack of Opportunity
classFeatures.description: Reaction roll when adversary attempts to leave Melee range

classFeatures.name: Combat Training
classFeatures.description: Ignore weapon burden, add level to physical damage rolls

features.name: Courage
features.description: Gain Hope when you fail with Fear

features.name: Battle Ritual
features.description: Clear 2 Stress and gain 2 Hope before dangerous situations

features.name: Rise to the Challenge
features.description: Roll d20 as Hope Die at 2 or fewer HP

features.name: Camaraderie
features.description: Extra Tag Team Roll, reduced cost for allies

features.name: Slayer
features.description: Pool of Slayer Dice to add to attack/damage rolls

features.name: Weapon Specialist
features.description: Add secondary weapon damage die

features.name: Martial Preparation
features.description: Party gains Martial Preparation downtime move

wizard.name: Wizard
wizard.description: Wizards acquire and hone magical power through years of learning using books, stones, potions, and herbs.
wizard.classItems: A book you're trying to translate or a tiny, harmless elemental pet

hopeFeature.name: Not This Time
hopeFeature.description: Spend 3 Hope to force an adversary to reroll an attack or damage roll.

classFeatures.name: Prestidigitation
classFeatures.description: Perform harmless magical effects at will

classFeatures.name: Strange Patterns
classFeatures.description: Choose a number 1-12; gain Hope or clear Stress when rolled

features.name: Prepared
features.description: Take additional domain card

features.name: Adept
features.description: Mark Stress instead of spending Hope to double Experience modifier

features.name: Accomplished
features.description: Another additional domain card

features.name: Brilliant
features.description: Another additional domain card, Honed Expertise

features.name: Battlemage
features.description: Additional Hit Point slot

features.name: Face Your Fear
features.description: Deal extra 1d10 magic damage on success with Fear

features.name: Conjure Shield
features.description: Add Proficiency to Evasion with 2+ Hope

features.name: Have No Fear
features.description: Extra damage increases to 3d10
